$comment: THE BOOTH — one place for the commentary voice identity. The offline stem build (scripts/dev/render-commentary.mjs) and the runtime name-clip renderer (src/renderer/lib/commentaryAudio.ts) both read this file, so a name is always spoken by the same engine + voice + style as the stems around it. Swapping engines = change `engine` and the per-speaker `voiceId`/`referenceSample`, then rebuild the stems. See docs/BROADCAST-PACKAGE.md.
